Tekton Chains currently supports multiple kinds of attestations and the in-toto attestation format is one of the popular ones in the open source community. Tekton Chains currently use [Results](https://github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/blob/main/docs/tasks.md#emitting-results) and [Params](https://github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/blob/main/docs/tasks.md#specifying-parameters) for such type of attestation generation.

With SLSA being established, there is a rise in demand for achieving richer provenance within attestations. [In-toto](https://github.com/in-toto/attestation) provides a way for supporting richer provenance inside Predicates.

Tekton Chains currently use [Results](https://github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/blob/main/docs/tasks.md#emitting-results) and [Params](https://github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/blob/main/docs/tasks.md#specifying-parameters) for such type of attestation generation.
